Connections Discovery System Network Connections Discovery Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of network connections to or from the compromised system they are currently accessing or from remote systems by querying for information over the network. Windows Utilities and commands that acquire this information include netstat, "net use," and "net session" with Net. Mac and Linux In Mac and Linux, netstat and lsof can be used to list current connections. who -a and w can be used to show which users are currently logged in, similar to "net session". ID:\xc2 T1049 Tactic: Discovery Platform:\xc2 Linux, macOS, Windows Permissions Required:\xc2 User, Administrator Data Sources:\xc2 Process monitoring, Process command-line parameters Version:\xc2 1.0 Mitigations This type of attack technique cannot be easily mitigated with preventive controls since it is based on the abuse of system features. Examples Name Description admin@338 admin@338 actors used the following command following exploitation of a machine with LOWBALL malware to display network connections: netstat -ano >> %temp%\\download [34] APT1 APT1 used the net use command to get a listing on network connections. [35] APT3 APT3 has a tool that can enumerate current network connections. [7] [31] [32] APT32 APT32 used the netstat -anpo tcp command to display TCP connections on the victim's machine. [33] BlackEnergy BlackEnergy has gathered information about local network connections using netstat. [19] [20] Carbon Carbon uses the netstat -r and netstat -an commands. [16] Comnie Comnie executes the netstat -ano command. [15] Duqu The discovery modules used with Duqu can collect information on network connections. [11] Empire Empire can enumerate the current network connections of a host. [4] Epic Epic uses the net use, net session, and netstat commands to gather information on network connections. [8] [9] GravityRAT GravityRAT uses the netstat command to find open ports on the victim\xe2\x80\x99s machine. [21] jRAT jRAT can list network connections. [25] Ke3chang Ke3chang performs local network connection discovery using netstat. [36] [37] Kwampirs Kwampirs collects a list of active and listening connections by using the command netstat -nao as well as a list of available network mappings with net use. [13] menuPass menuPass has used net use to conduct connectivity checks to machines. [28] nbtstat nbtstat can be used to discover current NetBIOS sessions. Net Commands such as net use and net session can be used in Net to gather information about network connections from a particular host. [3] netstat netstat can be used to enumerate local network connections, including active TCP connections and other network statistics. [2] OilRig OilRig has used netstat -an on a victim to get a listing of network connections. [29] OSInfo OSInfo enumerates the current network connections similar to net use . [7] PlugX PlugX has a module for enumerating TCP and UDP network connections and associated processes using the netstat command. [23] Poseidon Group Poseidon Group obtains and saves information about victim network interfaces and addresses. [27] PoshC2 PoshC2 contains an implementation of netstat to enumerate TCP and UDP connections. [5] POWRUNER POWRUNER may collect active network connections by running netstat -an on a victim. [10] Pupy Pupy has a built-in utility command for netstat, can do net session through PowerView, and has an interactive shell which can be used to discover additional information. [1] RATANKBA RATANKBA uses netstat -ano to search for specific IP address ranges. [6] RedLeaves RedLeaves can enumerate drives and Remote Desktop sessions. [22] Remsec Remsec can obtain a list of active connections and open ports. [14] SHOTPUT SHOTPUT uses netstat to list TCP connection status. [17] Soft Cell Soft Cell used netstat -oan to obtain information about the victim network connections. [39] SpeakUp SpeakUp uses the arp -a command. [24] Sykipot Sykipot may use netstat -ano to display active network connections. [12] Threat Group-3390 Threat Group-3390 has used net use to conduct internal discovery of systems. The group has also used quser.exe to identify existing RDP sessions on a victim. [30] Turla Turla surveys a system upon check-in to discover active local network connections using the netstat -an, net use, net file, and net session commands. Turla RPC backdoors have also enumerated the IPv4 TCP connection table via the GetTcpTable2 API call. [8] [38] Volgmer Volgmer can gather information about TCP connection state. [18] Zebrocy Zebrocy uses netstat -aon to gather network connection information. [26] Detection System and network discovery techniques normally occur throughout an operation as an adversary learns the environment. Data and events should not be viewed in isolation, but as part of a chain of behavior that could lead to other activities, such as Lateral Movement, based on the information obtained. Monitor processes and command-line arguments for actions that could be taken to gather system and network information. Remote access tools with built-in features may interact directly with the Windows API to gather information.
